annotations.title: US state economies (BLS, FHFA, BEA, Philadelphia Fed)

description: A US state's economy beside the nation's: the unemployment rate, payroll jobs, the Philadelphia Fed's coincident index of activity, house prices (FHFA) and real GDP, each with its change on a year; or every state and DC ranked by unemployment or by the growth of jobs, activity or house prices. A plain summary first. No key.

rank.description: Instead of one state: every state and DC ranked by this measure (unemployment by its rate, the others by their change on a year).

state.description: A state or DC by name or postal code ("Texas", "TX").

name: state_economy

outputSchema.description: For a state, rows are measures in the order of columns beside the US; with rank, rows are states, highest first.
